description: Compare two versions of a STEP assembly: which parts were added, removed, renamed or replaced, which parts changed shape (with the changed features, as in compare), quantity changes, and which parts or subassemblies moved or changed parent. Use it when the files are assemblies (compare reports them as unsupported) or the user asks what changed in a product structure. Also works when one side is a single part. Files are read locally and never uploaded. Typical time: a few seconds for tens of parts, up to a minute for hundreds. If warnings contains not_all_parts_compared, say so and offer to rerun with a higher max_detailed_parts. Requires CAD Compare Pro (see describe → license).

a.description: Absolute path to the first assembly file (A, usually the older version) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

b.description: Absolute path to the second assembly file (B) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

max_detailed_parts.description: How many changed-looking parts to compare geometrically (default 40; each takes about 0.1–5 s)

name: compare_assembly

parts.description: Part instances inside it (1 for a part)

path.description: Position in the tree, "top / sub / part"

moved.description: Instances (parts or subassemblies) placed differently in B

count.description: How many instances moved the same way (path is then the definition's path)

parts.description: Part instances inside it (1 for a part)

path.description: Position in the tree, "top / sub / part"

reparented.description: Instances that moved to another subassembly

not_compared.description: Part pairs skipped because of max_detailed_parts

added.description: Parts only in B, with how many instances

origin_moved.description: Same shape, but the part's own origin moved (the CAD model was re-based)

renamed.description: Same part under a new name; match says how it was recognised (identical data, identical shape, identical shape with a moved part origin)

replaced.description: A part swapped for another one (same_shape null: not compared)

shape_changed.description: Parts present in both whose shape changed

compared.description: false: over the limit of parts compared in detail, the shape may have changed

features.description: Changed features, as in compare; locations in the part's own coordinates

attr.description: For modified: the size that changed (diameter, radius, depth, width, angle, height, length)

from.description: Value in A (mm, angles in degrees)

location.description: Where in B, mm (in A for removed)

offset.description: For moved: displacement from A to B, mm

size.description: For added, removed and moved: the feature's own sizes, e.g. {diameter: 6} (mm, angles in degrees; names as in attr)

type.description: What changed, e.g. through_hole, hole, fillet, chamfer, boss, pocket, slot, outer_diameter, face

too_different.description: The versions differ too much to list individual features

verdict.description: same: the same parts, in the same places, with the same shapes

warnings.description: not_all_parts_compared (raise max_detailed_parts for a full check), some_parts_too_different
